$description: Hand-written. Line widths, the same in every mode. Outlines are lines, not containers (decision 2026-10-12): an outline only ever shows the same surface on both sides. Two widths at most, as in the infographics round.

sm.$description: The default: dividers, outlines, the secondary button's outline, inner lines and arrows in a diagram.

md.$description: A heavier outer outline in a graphic, one step above the lines inside it.
